CONCLUSIONS.heading: CONCLUSIONS
CONCLUSIONS.text: Based on the above-mentioned information, the HMPC is of the opinion that a Community herbal monograph on Citrus bergamia Risso et Poiteau, aetheroleum, cannot be established unless new data are provided. To read more about the assessment carried out, a link is provided to the page where to access the assessment report on Citrus bergamia Risso et Poiteau, aetheroleum, and its list of references. http://www.ema.europa.eu/ema/index.jsp?curl=pages/medicines/herbal/medicines/herbal_med_0000 59.jsp&mid=WC0b01ac058001fa1d
